# zkdb (`SMC17/zkdb`)

> Columnar time-series database in pure Zig with q/kdb+ semantics: typed vectors, SIMD aggregation, asof and window joins.

## Repository & Docs
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SMC17/zkdb
- [README](https://github.com/SMC17/zkdb/blob/main/README.md)
- [Build](https://github.com/SMC17/zkdb/blob/main/build.zig)
- [Examples](https://github.com/SMC17/zkdb/tree/main/examples)
- [Source](https://github.com/SMC17/zkdb/tree/main/src)
